document_conflicts.explanation: The Form C risk factor states substantial doubt about going concern. The audit report has no going-concern paragraph, and audited Note 4 says statements are prepared on a going-concern basis and management believes crowdfunding will provide resources.

The Form C says notes cannot convert before a Reg A or similar follow-on event. Audited Note 5 lists change of control, private replacement financing or recapitalization as triggers, so a private financing could trigger conversion. The conversion price is undisclosed in both.

document_conflicts.explanation: The issuer's six-month runway claim implies a monthly net loss that may be higher than the FY2025 audited loss level implies. The averaging period used is not disclosed.
The Form C says up to 180 days; the Subscription Agreement says up to 270 days.
The issuer says its $120,000 therapy price is about 2/3 of approved drugs, but the same document lists generic riluzole at $276-$360 per year.

'Only later-stage non-pharma solution' and 'extensive testing' are asserted although the only reported data are from mice. The video transcript says 'reversal' while the Form C describes survival extension.
The issuer lists company-owned patents and says it controls critical IP, while risk factors refer to future patents and possibly defective IP rights.
Audited statements show 1 share at 2025-12-31; the Form C shows 75,000,001 after a 2026-06-25 ratification of an earlier issuance whose date is not stated. Treated as history, not a conflict.
